title: Catalog cards: add Traditional Wear photos as static assets and render real images

requirements.summary: Add the two uploaded photos as static frontend assets and include 4:3 (1200x900) catalog-card variants.
acceptanceCriteria: The repo contains the uploaded images under a static assets path (e.g., frontend/public/assets/...) and also contains 4:3 variants (e.g., 1200x900) for consistent catalog display.
The 4:3 variants preserve the subject clearly (no important cropping of the outfit).

file_operations.description: Add the original uploaded image as a static frontend asset for catalog usage.
Add the original uploaded image as a static frontend asset for catalog usage.
Add the 4:3 cropped/resized (1200x900) catalog-card variant for 1770713137991.png as a static frontend asset.
Add the 4:3 cropped/resized (1200x900) catalog-card variant for 1770713334950.png as a static frontend asset.

requirements.summary: Render style images in catalog style cards using style.image and add a clean fallback when images are missing or fail to load.
acceptanceCriteria: Catalog cards show an image in the existing 4:3 media area for styles that have a valid image path.
If an image fails to load, the UI does not break and shows a clean fallback state (no broken-image icon in the final design).

file_operations.description: Create a small catalog-only image component that renders a 4:3 image (object-fit cover) from a provided src (style.image) and switches to a styled fallback state on missing/failed load (no broken-image icon).

Replace the current placeholder icon/text block in the 4:3 media area with the new CatalogCardImage component, passing style.image as the src and ensuring layout stays in the existing aspect-[4/3] container.

requirements.summary: Wire the new static photo filenames into catalog rendering so Traditional Wear styles (at minimum Pathani Kurta) resolve to the new images.
acceptanceCriteria: Calling getCatalog() returns style.image values that match the newly added static asset filenames/paths for the mapped Traditional Wear styles.
In the Catalog section, “Pathani Kurta” renders with the mapped uploaded photo.

file_operations.description: Add a frontend-side normalization/override step after getCatalog() so mapped styles (at minimum name === "Pathani Kurta") have style.image set to the new static asset path (e.g., /assets/generated/catalog-pathani-kurta.dim_1200x900.png), keeping the rest of the catalog unchanged.
